daemon.not-connected: Can't connect to the daemon (vpnd). Relaunch the daemon or restart the app.

tunnel.same-entry-exit-gw: Cannot connect with the same entry and exit server. Change either the entry or exit server and reconnect.
tunnel.invalid-entry-gw-country: Invalid country for entry server. Choose another and reconnect.
tunnel.invalid-exit-gw-country: Invalid country for exit server. Choose another and reconnect.
tunnel.invalid-entry-gw-id: Entry server is offline. Choose another and reconnect.
tunnel.invalid-exit-gw-id: Exit server is offline. Choose another and reconnect.
tunnel.credential-wasted-entry-gw: Entry server is not responding or responding badly to a bandwidth increase.
tunnel.credential-wasted-exit-gw: Exit server is not responding or responding badly to a bandwidth increase.
tunnel.performant-entry-gw-unavailable: Can't reach entry server. Try another!
tunnel.performant-exit-gw-unavailable: Can't reach exit server. Try another!
tunnel.max-devices-reached: Account device limit exceeded. Please remove a device from your account before connecting.
tunnel.bandwidth-exceeded: Monthly data limit reached. Contact Support for a quick data boost.
tunnel.subscription-expired: Subscription has expired. Kill switch protects you. Tap Stop and renew your plan.
tunnel.device-time-out-of-sync: Device time is out of sync. Please synchronize your device's time with the internet.
tunnel.ipv6-unavailable: IPv6 is not available in the system. Disable in the settings to use IPv4
tunnel.device-logged-out: This device has been logged out. Please log in to continue using the VPN.

account.bandwidth-exceeded: Monthly data limit reached. Contact Support for a quick data boost.
account.no-subscription: You don’t have an active plan. Tap Get started to begin anonymous browsing.
